comment: (B) EACH LAND'S EDGE DISCARD AT ITS OWN QUEUE POSITION. T3, Land's Edge + an untapped Mountain, hand two Islands + Lightning Bolt; the human queues 'discard an Island, Bolt, discard the other Island'. Before: the plan's ONE DiscardToLandsEdge action (a count of 2) fired after every cast, so both discards came after Bolt. Now each queued `le=` step is one unit fired where it stands. 20 - 2 - 3 - 2 = 13.
